data.explanation: This is a private bill (not via statutory health insurance) for your daughter's occupational therapy sessions from September to November 2026, totalling €430.00. It is tax-free of VAT under §4 No.14 UStG. You must transfer the amount to the practice's IBAN by the deadline shown, which the app calculates from the invoice date. If you miss it, the practice could send a reminder or charge late fees, though none are mentioned here. Keep this invoice, as such private medical expenses for a child may be claimable as extraordinary burdens on your tax return — a tax advisor can confirm if you exceed the deductible threshold.
